Name: Small WIld Farm moveable greenhouse
Author: ClosetOtakuChu
Description: DISCLAIMER: THIS IS NOT A FUNCTIONING MOD THIS JUST REPLACES A  FILE FOR SMALL WILD FARM. You will need to download the original Small Wild Farm Map. https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6296?tab=description This is just a replacement file for the Farm.tbin located in the asset folder of the mod. Simple delete the old file and replace it with this one. You should now be able to move the greenhouse without gaining a huge chunk of unusable land. This is by far my favorite farm map for stardew and I was updating it for my own uses. I hope other people will also get to experience this awesome map.

Downloads.Description: Basically the same as before I just made the map compatible with the latest version
